correctness.rationale: The ordinary cut facets are complements of disconnected induced triples; its Alexander dual consists of sets all of whose three-subsets induce connected paths. Cubicity and triangle-freeness imply exactly n tetrahedra from rung squares, 6n triangles, and all edges. The displayed sequence of 6n elementary free-face collapses leaves a connected graph with 2n(n-3) edges and cycle rank 2n(n-4)+1; integral Alexander duality plus the full skeleton, Hurewicz and Whitehead recover the wedge in dimension 2n-4. Independently rebuilt and literally checked every claimed free-pair collapse for each n=4,...,18, including n=4 wraparound and stage ordering; all pass. This is a uniform proof rather than an infinite inference from the finite checks.
residual_risks: The theorem is for ordinary three-cut only, n>=4; total cut has different facets and degrees.

value.rationale: The ordinary Möbius-ladder three-cut classification is a natural valuable question in isolation, but the exact homotopy theorem for the whole stated family was already published. final_claim: For every n>=4, the ordinary (not total) three-cut complex Delta_3(M_{2n}) of the Möbius ladder is integrally homotopy equivalent to a wedge of 2n(n-4)+1 spheres S^{2n-4}.
